_meta.source: Curated from Labuza & Schmidl 1985, Labuza & Fu 1993, Taoukis & Labuza 1997, FSSAI 2011, Kumar & Prasad 2010 — see docs/BIBLIOGRAPHY.bib
_meta.calibration_note: Ea_over_R and base_hours_at_20C are literature priors. Field refit in docs/calibration/ per docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md P2 L2.1-L2.2. Alpha/beta (Phi_env) empirical for Punjab Loo/monsoon — refit quarterly.

units.critical_temp_c: celsius, beyond which reefer mandatory irrespective of t_safe

Dairy.label: Tier 1 — Chilled Dairy (Verka/Amul Milk, Paneer, Dahi, Chaas)

Prepared.label: Tier 2 — Cooked / Langar Meals (Dal, Rice, Khichdi, Sabzi, Banquet Gravies)
Prepared.fssai_clause: Cooked food: hold >65C or <5C; rapid fermentation risk

Produce.label: Tier 3 — Mandi Fresh Produce (Palak, Tomatoes, Cauliflower, Coriander)
Produce.notes: Transpiration & wilting driven; humidity term beta highly influential

Bakery.label: Tier 4 — Bakery & Semi-Perishable (Pav, Bread, Rusks, Cooked Rotis)
Bakery.notes: Humidity staling index; lower Ea => flatter T response

Grains.label: Tier 5 — Grains & Staples (Whole Wheat Atta, Rice, Dal Pulses, Oil)
Grains.notes: Moisture/weevil control dominates over Arrhenius; keep dry

decay_model.phi_env: Phi_env(T,H) = exp(alpha*(T - T_base) + beta*max(0, H - H_threshold))

phi_params.citation: [@labuza1993kinetics — humidity extension calibrated Punjab summer 2024-25; see docs/calibration/phi_env.md before claiming generality]
